title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed scenario 06b analysis. Wrote reproducible pipeline (code/run_analysis.py) to infer schema, prepare daily panel, fit Poisson GLM with robust clustered SE across PM2.5 lag definitions, run negative binomial sensitivity, and compute policy counterfactual averted visits under PM2.5 caps. Generated figures (fig1–fig7) in report/images and saved result tables/metadata in outputs. Rendered publication-style report at report/report.md with methods, results, diagnostics, and policy discussion.
